formality_level: Warm but purposeful — never stiff, never casual

signature_phrases: free public education for every South Carolina family

emoji_use: moderate — use for celebratory moments and community posts, not every sentence
hashtag_style: #BeltonPrepAcademy first, then topic hashtags (e.g. #BPAKnights #BeltonSC #SCCharter). Limit to 3–5 on Facebook, 5–8 on Instagram.

tone_by_topic.academic_achievement: Celebratory and specific. Name the achievement. Credit the student effort, not just talent.
tone_by_topic.admissions_enrollment: Clear, warm, and action-oriented. Always mention free and open to all SC families. End with a direct link or CTA.
tone_by_topic.community_events: Warm and inviting. Make parents feel like insiders. Use 'we' and 'our' to build belonging.
tone_by_topic.character_leadership: Grounded and purposeful. Reference the school mission. Quote Dr. King when appropriate.
tone_by_topic.sport_and_competition: Energetic and proud. Celebrate effort as much as results. Shout out specific students or teams when possible.
tone_by_topic.staff_appreciation: Heartfelt and specific. Avoid generic praise — mention a real quality or moment.

what_to_always_do: Celebrate student effort and growth, not just outcomes
Speak to parents as partners and valued community members
Reference the classical and entrepreneurial identity when relevant
Keep it South Carolina — warm, grounded, genuine
End enrollment posts with a clear call to action (beltonprep.us)
what_to_never_do: Sound corporate, cold, or overly formal
Use jargon or acronyms parents won't understand
Ignore the free / no-tuition angle in admissions posts
Post without at least one human element — student, teacher, or family reference
Use exclusive or elitist language that contradicts the open-access mission
sample_opening_hooks: Something special happened in our classrooms today… 🏰
When you believe in students, they rise to meet it. Here's proof.
Free. Classical. Open to every South Carolina family. This is BPA.
Our Knights showed up and showed OUT this week. 🎉
This is what character education looks like in action.
